disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean lead (ug/g dry weight) with SD for 104 market foods from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, spanning vegetables, fruits, legumes, cereals, dairy, beverages, sweets, meat and fish, eggs and oils.

study.design: market-basket survey of 104 representative food items; three samples per item pooled, triplicate analysis; dietary intake estimate
study.origin: not stated (many items imported; country of origin not given)
study.market: local markets of Riyadh city, Saudi Arabia
study.method: dried at 100 C, milled; hot-plate wet acid digestion (acids per food category), ICP-AES (Thermo iCAP 6500)
study.qa: spike recovery 97.55 +/- 1.6%; no certified reference material reported

unresolved: Tables 2, 3 and 6 print rounded food-group lead concentrations used for intake calculations (e.g. vegetables 0.025 ug/g); these are derived group averages and were not recorded as findings. Table 3 lists potatoes at 0.013 ug/g versus 0.003 in Table 1.
Basis: Table 1 header states ug/g dry weight; samples were dried at 100 C before analysis. No moisture contents are given, so fresh-weight values cannot be derived.
Several Table 1 product names are brand names; they were anonymized as retail products. Row 93 product identity (fish versus luncheon slices) is unclear.
Abstract prints egg 0.079 ug/g and text prints chicken 0.068 and Galaxy-type confectionery 0.085 ug/g; Table 1 values were used.
